ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Credential Dumping Attempt Using New NetworkProvider - REG
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when an attacker tries to add a new network provider in order to dump clear text credentials, similar to how the NPPSpy tool does it

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\System\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\NetworkProvider.*")) AND  NOT ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\System\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services\\\\WebClient\\\\NetworkProvider.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\System\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services\\\\LanmanWorkstation\\\\NetworkProvider.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\System\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services\\\\RDPNP\\\\NetworkProvider.*")) OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\poqexec\.exe")
